prompt: shop-gitops/ is delivered with Argo CD. I want the image ghcr.io/acme/shop-gitops:4f2a9c1 in production. Explain exactly what `graph-agents-cli deploy --env prod --image ghcr.io/acme/shop-gitops:4f2a9c1` will do, and who has to do what before the new image runs in the cluster. Don't run it.

checks.why: in argocd mode deploy never runs helm: it opens a pull request
the merge by a code owner is the single production gate

reference: In argocd mode `deploy --env prod --image <ref>` never runs helm, never contacts the cluster and never merges: it writes the tag into deployment/helm/shop-gitops/values-prod.yaml on a branch deploy/prod/<short sha> built from origin/main and opens a pull request. A code owner of values-prod.yaml must review and merge it (no self-approval, pr_checks green); Argo CD then reconciles from main, and the prod Application has no automated sync, so an operator syncs it after the merge.
